name: aios-keepwarm
description: Keeps Claude's prompt cache warm while you take a break, so the next message costs a read, not a full re-write, and stops a cold send once to show its price. Based on cache-tax by Karan Bansal (MIT, https://github.com/karanb192/cache-tax). Warming uses model requests and costs tokens. Requires Claude Code 2.1.287+.
